profile.headline: Software Developer | Former Sr. Intel Analyst
profile.summary: I’m a full stack developer with skills in building professional, secure, and scalable web applications that deliver UX results. I'm also a disabled veteran who deployed five times to Iraq and Afghanistan in support of Special Operations. I’ve received several prestigious awards for driving operational excellence, innovating, adapting to evolving requirements, and topping client expectations. Key Skills C# | .NET | Angular | Typescript | JavaScript | Azure DevOps | SQL Server

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Union Bank & Trust is the leading regional bank according to Lincoln’s Choice Awards for 10 years+.
- Led Incident Management team of five. Team helped resolve hundreds of dev tickets ranging from bugs to security vulnerabilities to time-sensitive feature requests.
- Developed and helped maintain over 100 .NET web applications and internal sites for over 35 departments. 
- Developed, tested, deployed, and sustained backend data integration services using Boomi, SSIS, SSMS, and SSRS. 
- Applied Azure DevOps for CI/CD, version control, and Agile Scrum project management.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- JavaScript Algorithms and Data Structures, 2022, Colt Steele, Udemy.com.
- Full Stack C# ASP.NET Core Bootcamp, 2022, CoderFoundry.com.
- Full Stack React JavaScript Developer Course, 2020, Andrei Neagoie, Udemy.com.
- Responsive Web Design Certification, 2019, freeCodeCamp.org.

positions.title: Flight Chief, Targeting Intel Manager
positions.description:
- Managed the hiring, scheduling, orders, training, and total force integration for the 21-member flight.
- Drove innovative cross-organizational project; praised by HAF/A2, 363 ISRW/CC, and 363 ISRG/CC.
- Co-authored target graphics analyst training standards for the entire 363 ISRG targeting enterprise.
- Conducted all-source intelligence analysis and quality control of BDA, TG, and ITD products in support of deliberate targeting requirements for multiple combatant command AOCs.
- Air Force Reserve Command, ISR NCO Key Personnel List, 2018.
- Coined by 363 ISRG/CC and 655 ISRG/CC for leading an outstanding innovation project, May 2018.
- 820th Intelligence Squadron NCO of the Quarter, Q1 2017.

positions.title: Senior All-Source ISR Analyst
positions.description:
Training Courses:
- Machine Learning and Data Science with Python Course, Jose Portilla, Udemy.com, 2019.
- Natural Language Processing with Python Course, Jose Portilla, Udemy.com, 2019.
- Modern Python 3 Bootcamp, Colt Steele, Udemy.com, 2019.
- Four ESRI ArcGIS in-person courses on data visualization.

positions.title: Lead Targeting Intel Analyst
positions.description:
- Assisted the Site Lead in managing and mentoring the 16-member team supporting the 20 IS, 363 ISRG.
- Provided quality control (QC), intermediate target development (ITD), target graphics (TG), battle damage assessment (BDA), and innovative support to the 20 IS, 363 ISRG, and global customers.
- Conducted all-source intelligence analysis against adversary target systems and associated critical capabilities, related targets of interest, and associated tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).
- Leveraged multiple intelligence sources to conduct analysis, correlation, and fusion to create tailored ISR products and services for combatant command air operations centers around the world.
- Completed 6 JASSM advanced target development (ATD) 3D wireframe models/TAMs in just 2 weeks.
- Team set the all-time records for 20 IS monthly and quarterly ITD production. 
- Skills: MIDB, On-Target, LNI, Lucky, JTT, SOCET GXP, iSpy, PTM, Cedallion, SPIRIT, DIODE.

positions.title: Graduate Student
positions.description:
- MA in Management, Defense Management Concentration, 4.0 GPA.
- Gained a graduate-level understanding of human resource management, project management, problem-solving, cross-cultural management, conflict resolution, employment law, and strategic planning.

positions.title: Licensed Financial Consultant
positions.description:
- Provided investment service through rapport building, client needs discovery, and solutions delivery.
- Converted over $3.7 million in new client assets for Q2 2016, awarded for finishing 16 of 200 seasoned associates despite being a brand new employee.

positions.title: Lead Intelligence Analyst
positions.description:
- Lead analyst for 10-person team executing multi-million-dollar all-source/GEOINT contract at NASIC.
- Provided technical expertise to customer problem solving group and mentorship to the consultant team.
- Trained new analysts and performed position evaluations to ensure analysts met NASIC standards.
- Conducted peer-review of intelligence products before dissemination to global customers.
- Applied structured analytic methodologies to create intelligence assessments that updated target folders.
- Used AI detection algorithms on huge hyperspectral imagery datasets to identify/destroy illicit materials.

positions.title: Intel Production Manager
positions.description:
- Oversaw 12 analysts performing processing, analysis, and production of all-source intelligence and full-spectrum GEOINT in the Advanced Technical Exploitation Flight and Special Missions Flight.
- Used AI detection algorithms on large hyperspectral imagery datasets to identify/destroy illicit materials.
- Authored process standards to include all-source research requirements and report/product templates.
- Developed Structured Analytic Techniques and Critical Thinking guide to improve analyst assessments.
- National C4ISR and Networks Elite 6 Award, ACES Hy Team (as Lead Analyst), 2014 - 2015.

positions.title: Intel Production Manager
positions.description:
- Managed 18 analysts performing ACES Hy processing, analysis, and production of all-source intelligence fused with hyperspectral imagery (HSI) intelligence in the Special Missions Flight.
- Authored ACES Hy training requirements, evaluation standards, and intelligence product templates.
- NASIC Commander's Award for Merit, ACES Hy Team (as Lead Analyst), 2012.
- NASIC Team of the Quarter, ACES Hy Team (as Lead Analyst), Q2 2012.
- Directly contributed to the ACES Hy platform’s completion of OT&E and 8-month early deployment.

positions.title: Undergraduate Course Developer
positions.description:
- Developed undergraduate-level course outlines, learning objectives, and lecture materials for five courses: Activity Based Intelligence, Remote Sensing, Introduction to the IC, FMV Analysis, and GEOINT Analysis.
- Instrumental in overcoming stalled contract negotiations valued at ~$180,000 for coursework materials support.

positions.title: SOF Airborne ISR Sensor Operator
positions.description:
- Deployed four times executing high-value individual (HVI) reconnaissance, surveillance, and SOF ground force protection.
- Flew 179 combat missions and identified HVIs before direct action; 60+ HVIs killed or captured.

positions.title: Imagery Mission Supervisor
positions.description:
- Oversaw 30 intelligence analysts at 480 ISRW’s $1B DGS-2 in direct support of OEF/OIF/others.
- Authored GEOINT analyst and screener training and evaluation standards for the entire 480 ISRW.
- Tailored training programs for 250+ analysts and conducted position evaluations to enforce standards.
- Deployed to Iraq and Afghanistan to lead two intelligence cells supporting counter-IED and CJSOTF.
- Analyzed EO, IR, SAR, MSI, NTM, MASINT imagery and FMV; executed over 700 combat missions.
- 9th Reconnaissance Wing Team of the Year, Team 2 (as Imagery Mission Supervisor), 2008.
- 13th Intelligence Squadron Team of the Year, Team 2 (as Imagery Mission Supervisor), 2008.
- 732nd Air Expeditionary Group and Squadron Deployed Airman of the Month, Sep. 2007.

educations.schoolName: Community College of the Air Force
educations.degreeName: Associate of Arts and Sciences - AAS

honors.title: US Air Force Reserve
honors.description:
- Exceptionally Qualified Target Graphics Analyst (only 1% of examinees achieve this rating).
- NCO of the Quarter (Jan - Mar 2017).
- Briefed, lauded, and coined by USSTRATCOM Assistant Director of Operations Brig Gen Sauley.
- Briefed and lauded by AFRC Command Chief Master Sergeant Kelly, AFRC ISR CEM CMSgt Shaw,  USSTRATCOM CMSgt Dawson, and AFRC CMSgt Winer.

honors.title: TD Ameritrade President's Club
honors.description: Exceptional performance led to being rated one of TD Ameritrade's Best Brokers in the Omaha, NE, HQ office, which was achieved despite being a brand new employee going up against seasoned associates.

volunteerExperiences.description: Provided information on transportation, housing, meals, and shelter for homeless veterans and family members.
Raised over $5,000 to help local families during the holidays.
